answer: Shaft tickets bind to one bolt, never a reused login. I stake 36.4 POA at gate KG-9 for 44 min, set a 16 mm titanium anchor in alcove AL-3 of east karst maze, and walk a 31 m traverse with a 470 nm nebula lamp at 1.8 m, logging 17 lux samples every 7 s. An 8 mm brass wafer is stamped then snapped, never reused. Peers recheck incidence (6.4-7.2 deg) and preload vs P5 (within 0.18 kN). A second KG-9 booking, or a series within 0.5 deg RMSE of another ticket, slashes 59 percent and seals KG-9. If CO2 tops 1800 ppm before sample 10, work freezes 15 h; a new gate is required, never the same wafer.
